# Legacy App

Stock reservations per item, with a cancellation log. The same rules apply as in the
app's own pages; questions a person answers there are explicit parameters here.

| Type | Effect | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Legacy.Stock.Get` | Read-only | Reserved and still-available quantity of one item. |
| `Legacy.Stock.List` | Read-only | All reservations or those matching an item filter, with count. |
| `Legacy.Stock.Reserve` | Commits | Adds to an item's reservation; refuses over stock unless `allowOverStock`. Not safe to repeat. |
| `Legacy.Stock.CancelReservation` | Commits | Cancels one item's reservation. Safe to repeat. |
| `Legacy.Stock.ReleaseAll` | Commits, irreversible | Releases every reservation matching a filter; needs `expectedCount` from List. |
| `Help.Legacy.Get` | Read-only | This overview. |

For the contract of any one type, call `Help.Implementation.Get` with its name.
